children.label: Errors are not a sign you did something wrong

children.value:
Every R user — instructors included — sees these same eight messages
constantly. An error is R telling you

where it got stuck, which
makes it the single best debugging clue you have, not a signal to start
over. Every message on this page is

, produced by
actually running the broken code shown — not retyped from memory — so what
you see here is exactly what you’ll see on your own screen.
